title: Volcano Easy Valve Balloon with Adapter
description:
The easy valve balloon with adapter now makes exchanging the balloons on your volcano easy valve possible.

The Adapter allows you to pull off a used balloon and attach a new one to the valve and mouthpiece, just as with the solid valve.

FEATURES
Maintenance-free Valve Balloon and Mouthpiece
Light, robust and easy to use
Optimized Filling Chamber design with less condensation
Filling Chamber Reducer available
Compatible with Dosing Capsules
Less vapor loss due to better tightness
New: Exchangeable balloons

INCLUDES
1 easy valve balloon with adapter
1 balloon fixation ring
